Title: General availability: Azure Container Registry OCI artifact support

Body.Content:
Azure Container Registry adds Helm Charts, Singularity support and new OCI artifact supported formats. In addition to Docker container images, Azure Container Registry can now store related content formats such as Helm charts, OCI Artifacts and images built to the Open Container Initiative (OCI) Image Format Specification.

Learn more
